brief_rationale: The doctor completed all responsibility-chain requirements: systematic red-flag screening for stroke/bleeding/diabetes, appropriate respect for document uncertainty without unsupported interpretations, correct antithrombotic and diabetes medication boundaries without independent changes, clear emergency thresholds, and an executable plan with owners/timing. Multiple high-order points were actively completed with meaningful impact: reconciling reassuring exam with concerning vascular context (HO1), correcting family misconceptions about antithrombotics (HO2), and dynamically reprioritizing when hypoglycemia occurred (HO4). The episode closed safely with family teach-back confirming understanding of warning signs, medication continuation, and next steps.
